paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Диаграмата илюстрира сравнение на средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния в различните слоеве на модела при три различни конфигурации: преди gate, след gate и baseline.

Оста X е обозначена с “Layer” и показва линейна скала, започваща от 0 и достигаща до 20. Стойностите са разположени на интервали от 1, с ясно видими стойности 0 и 20 в края на оста. Оста Y е обозначена с “Mean” и показва линейна скала, започваща от 0 и достигаща до 4. Стойностите са разположени на интервали от 0.5, с ясно видими стойности 0 и 4 в края на оста.

Линията с обозначение "hidden state mean before gate", илюстрирана с синьо-разкъсана линия, започва на 0 и достига до 2.8. Линията се покачва постепенно до около 3.3 в слой 12, след което рязко се понижава и остава на нива около 0.71. Линията с обозначение "hidden state mean after gate", илюстрирана с оранжево-точкирана линия, започва на 0 и достига до 0.05. Линията остава на нива около 0.05 през целия период на почистването. Линията с обозначение "baseline mean", илюстрирана с зелена плътна линия, започва на 0.03 и достига до 0.04. Линията остава на нива около 0.04 през целия период.
model_annotations.Chinese: 图表展示了在不同模型层中的绝对隐藏状态均值的比较，比较了预加权、后加权和基线配置。x轴标记为“层”，刻度类型为线性，数值范围从 0 到大约 20，间隔为 1。y轴标记为“均值”，刻度类型为线性，数值范围从大约 0 到 4。蓝色虚线代表预加权隐藏状态均值，其平均值为 0.71。此线在约层 15 时接近零，然后迅速上升，在层 23 处达到一个峰值，约为 2.8。橙色点线代表后加权隐藏状态均值，其平均值为 0.05。绿色实线代表基线均值，其平均值为 0.04。领导线表现出比后加权均值略高的值，尤其是在最后一层。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” represents the layer number with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 20, with tick labels appearing every 2 units. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Abs”, uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 4, with tick labels spaced by 1 units. The blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before gating, which starts at approximately 0.6 and rises to a peak value of approximately 2.8 around layer 23, subsequently decreasing to a value around 0.7 at layer 20. The orange dotted line depicts the hidden state mean after gating, beginning at approximately 0.0 and remaining relatively constant around 0.05 throughout the plotted range. The green solid line displays the baseline hidden state mean, starting at approximately 0.03 and generally remaining close to 0.04 across the x-axis.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die mittlere absolute Wahrscheinlichkeit der versteckten Zustände über Schichten eines neuronalen Netzes dar und vergleicht drei Konfigurationen: vor dem Gate, nach dem Gate und einer Baseline. Die x-Achse, die „Schicht“ bezeichnet, reicht von 0 bis 20 und ist in regelmäßigen Intervallen mit einer Schrittweite von 1 angeordnet. Die y-Achse, die „Absolut“ bezeichnet, reicht von 0 bis 4 und ist in pauschalen Werten angeordnet. Die mittlere absolute Wahrscheinlichkeit des versteckten Zustands vor dem Gate (blaue gestrichelte Linie) bleibt durch ungefähr Schicht 15 nahe Null, steigt dann steil an und erreicht einen Spitzenwert von etwa 2,8 bei Schicht 23. Die mittlere absolute Wahrscheinlichkeit des versteckten Zustands nach dem Gate (orangepunkte) und die mittlere absolute Wahrscheinlichkeit der Baseline (grüne Linie) bleiben über den gesamten Bereich nahe Null, wobei die Baseline in den letzten Schichten leicht höhere Werte aufweist.
